questions.text: In SD-Access, which node maintains the EID-to-RLOC mapping database?
questions.explanation: The Control Plane Node uses LISP to maintain endpoint identifier to routing locator mappings. Edge Nodes connect endpoints. Border Nodes connect to external networks.

questions.text: What is the primary benefit of a spine-leaf architecture?
options: B. Predictable east-west latency and ECMP
questions.explanation: Spine-leaf provides consistent latency between any two leaf switches and enables equal-cost multipathing (ECMP). Every leaf connects to every spine, providing predictable performance for data center east-west traffic.

questions.text: What does VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) enable on a single router?
questions.explanation: VRF allows multiple independent routing table instances, enabling overlapping IP addresses across different tenants. This is foundational for MPLS L3VPN services.

questions.text: Which BGP attribute influences outbound traffic from the local AS?
questions.explanation: Local Preference influences outbound traffic from the local AS. Higher LP is preferred. MED influences inbound traffic. AS_PATH prepending is another method for outbound TE.

questions.text: What is the default OSPF network type on a serial interface with HDLC?
questions.explanation: Serial interfaces with HDLC/PPP default to point-to-point. No DR/BDR election occurs. Broadcast is default on Ethernet. Non-Broadcast was default on Frame Relay multipoint.

questions.text: Which multicast protocol uses explicit joins toward an RP and switches to an SPT after the first packet?
questions.explanation: PIM Sparse Mode uses shared trees rooted at the RP. After the first packet, the last-hop router can switch to a source-specific SPT for optimal forwarding. Dense Mode uses flood-and-prune.

questions.text: Which technology streams structured telemetry from devices to collectors using a push model?
questions.explanation: Model-driven telemetry uses gRPC/gNMI to push structured data to collectors, eliminating polling overhead. This is more scalable than SNMP pulls. SNMP traps are push-based but unstructured.

questions.text: Which Cisco ISE component enforces authentication and authorization policies?
questions.explanation: The Policy Service Node (PSN) enforces authentication, authorization, and posture assessment. The Admin Node provides the UI. The Monitoring Node collects logs. pxGrid enables data sharing.

questions.text: Which encryption protocol does WPA3 use for personal mode?
questions.explanation: WPA3 uses AES-GCMP (Galois/Counter Mode Protocol) with SAE (Simultaneous Authentication of Equals) for secure key exchange. WPA2 uses AES-CCMP. TKIP is deprecated.

questions.text: In JSON, what is the difference between {} and []?
questions.explanation: Curly braces define objects (key-value pairs). Square brackets define arrays (ordered lists). Both are fundamental to REST API data exchange in network automation.
